title: thalictrum tenuifolium subsp. galioides
intro: Thalictrum tenuifolium subsp. galioides, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. Meadow Rue is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include acting as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it effective in treating conditions such as urinary tract infections, bronchitis, and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of Thalictrum tenuifolium subsp. galioides include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
